note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after 56c2e06f0a). RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2 (Active) states: 'If the local system receives a TcpConnectionFails event (Event 18), the local system: - restarts the ConnectRetryTimer (with the initial value), - stops and clears the DelayOpenTimer (sets the value to zero), - releases all BGP resource, - increments the ConnectRetryCounter by 1, - optionally performs peer oscillation damping if the DampPeerOscillations attribute is set to TRUE, and - changes its state to Idle.' Section 8.2.1.3: 'If the flag indicating support for an optional timer (DelayOpen or DampPeerOscillations) cannot be set to TRUE, the timers and events supporting that option do not have to be supported.' 56c2e06f0a changed fsm.go::handleActive only by adding EventAutomaticStart to the ignored start-event arm ('The start events (Events 1, 3-7) are ignored in the Active state'); the Event 18 and TcpConnectionConfirmed arms are byte-for-byte unchanged. handleActive still moves Active to OpenSent at once on EventTCPConnectionConfirmed (DelayOpen FALSE path), no DelayOpenTimer exists in Ze, and the Event 18 arm only increments the counter and goes to Idle, without the restart/clear/release list. Event 3 with a passive peer enters Active exactly as Events 1 and 6 already did, so no new route holds a connection in Active. No test tags this row. The {gap} annotation (DelayOpen absent, an optional feature) still matches the code; DelayOpen remains planned in spec-bgp-fsm-delayopen-and-automatic-start row 6 but is not implemented by this commit. Verdict unchanged: unimplemented.
